description: Rinse surfaces in the wet back-of-house of a full-service restaurant (7.2 x 5.4 m dish room: an Advance Tabco FS-3-1824-24RL three-compartment pot sink with a pre-rinse unit and swing faucet, a soiled dish table with a 20 x 20 in pre-rinse sink, a prep sink and work table, a can-wash bay with a sloped floor drain and a hose reel) with a Franka Mobile FR3 Duo. Water is physical state from the supply to the drain: valves open only because a lever or wrist blade is moved by contact; jets are momentum-carrying packets that splatter (Bhunia-Lienhard); inertial thin films drain, round rims or separate (Duez), drip; pools fill, drain, overflow and float things; surfactant (with adsorption and foam), soil (soaking, impingement, Wilson cleaning front, shear) and contamination tracer are carried by the water; soap on a glass lowers the finger-pad friction.
count_scope: Nine named tasks; eight exact benchmark selections in task_set. Bare legacy selections retain their instructions, ids and scoring. rinse-dishware remains selectable outside the eight.
split_note: Legacy variations.json and its 8000 rows are unchanged. All tasks, including drain-wash-compartment, use the same frozen SHA-256 (task, seed) split for seeds 0..999; seeds 1000..9999 resolve with split null. New-task rows are resolved by surface_rinsing.task_set.catalogue.

evaluator.source: surface_rinsing/task_set/evaluator.py (explicit revised contract); surface_rinsing/task.py (legacy and pan)
evaluator.scope: World state only, with a settle rule (30 s of the whole world advanced with the robot holding, then measured and restored): surfactant per item and per 1 cm gauge, foam, sanitizer immersion time, soil per 1 cm gauge against the 1 ug/cm2 visible-residue limit, pooled water per item, placement in racks/colander/bowl, valves released and parked, soil, tracer and water on clean surfaces and the floor, glass/china impact speeds; no autonomous-solution claim.

qualification: Component-qualified with assisted evidence: water benches without the robot, phantom-actuated valves and phantom-held items, and robot demonstrations by a scripted operator through the robot interface; phantom forces where labelled.

task_set.score_rule: 1 on success, else 0.9 x continuous progress; None if state is unverifiable. Pan retains progress-v1 unchanged.

swaps.reason: Replaced for variety: it repeats the rinse, sanitize and place sequence of rinse-glassware. It stays selectable outside the eight. No task is shown to be impossible.

task_set.qualification: Checked in code and with pure-Python tests only. The revised contract and drain-wash-compartment are not yet run with the simulator or rendered, and no autonomous solution is claimed.
task_set.legacy: Omit contract (or use legacy) for every existing task to retain its original id, instruction, start and evaluator. The pan also accepts its progress-v1 contract explicitly.
